title: load_status N+1 queries per post in timeline
description: src/posting.rs:790-912. load_status() issues separate DB queries per post for: account, media attachments, tags, mentions (each mention may trigger another account lookup), favourited/reblogged/bookmarked state, card, and pinned status. For a 40-post timeline page, this means ~200-400 SQL queries. Each query is a roundtrip to SQLite. The ponytail comment on cards notes this but the pattern extends across all sub-resources. For SQLite over a Unix socket with sub-millisecond latency this is tolerable (40 posts * ~8 queries * 0.1ms = ~32ms), but it would be the first bottleneck to address if query latency increases.
